value.title: ddocs-validate sensor for project docs
value.summary: A back-pressure sensor that runs ddocs over docs/project/ and the community skill examples, wired into harness checks, just self-check and CI. From the #110 review, approved by the prime (packet job 4).

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Nothing checks that the project docs stay valid: #110 and the s02 work edit PRD 001 and roadmap 001 with ddocs, and a broken link or a hand-edited .dd.md would only be found by the next person who runs ddocs. This plan adds `just ddocs-check` (harness/scripts/ddocs-check.ts): every .dd.json under docs/project/ and skills/pij/references/community/ must pass `ddocs validate` with 0 errors and 0 warnings and `ddocs build --check`. ddocs is found by ruling C10 (PIJ_DDOCS, else PATH). Without it the sensor never passes: it fails as UNAVAILABLE, or in CI warns UNAVAILABLE on every run.

sections.name: goals
value: A broken link, a schema error or a stale .dd.md in docs/project/ or the skill examples fails the done gate.
The sensor never passes when it validated nothing: no ddocs, or no documents, is a named non-pass.
Local gate and CI run the same command.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Publishing ddocs or adding it as a dependency (it is not on an allowed registry yet).
Validating docs/plans/ or .dd/ fixtures (plans have their own `harness plan validate`; the role fixtures include documents that must fail).

value.claim: Sensor. `just ddocs-check` runs `ddocs validate --json` and `ddocs build --check --json` on every .dd.json under docs/project/ and skills/pij/references/community/ (node_modules skipped). A document passes only with status ok, 0 errors, 0 warnings, exit 0, and a current .dd.md. A directory it cannot read (including a missing root) fails by name with the path and the error, and finding no documents is a failure; neither ever counts as a pass. Failures name the file and ddocs' own message, with repo-relative paths.
value.receipt: assets/evidence/fires.txt cases 1-4 and 8-10 (chmod 000 docs/project fails by name; review F001); ddocs-check.test.ts unreadable-root regression

value.claim: Resolution (ruling C10). ddocs comes from PIJ_DDOCS (an absolute, executable path), else an absolute PATH entry; relative PATH entries are skipped so the cwd can't supply ddocs. A PIJ_DDOCS that is set but unusable refuses by name and never falls back to PATH. With no ddocs the sensor prints UNAVAILABLE and exits 2; with `--unavailable=warn` it exits 0 but prints UNAVAILABLE, plus a GitHub warning annotation under Actions.

Wiring. The `ddocs` sensor is added to .harness/extensions/checks/ (extension and instructions) and to `just self-check` together, as AGENTS.md requires; AGENTS.md's inventory names it. CI runs `just ddocs-check --unavailable=warn`.
value.receipt: CI run 41766023159 on 220fa2c: all jobs success; check (22) and check (24) print UNAVAILABLE and a 'ddocs-check UNAVAILABLE' warning annotation

value.claim: It fires. Breaking an example (a link to a missing requirement; a hand-edited .dd.md) makes the sensor fail; restoring it passes; no ddocs gives UNAVAILABLE. Transcript in assets/evidence/fires.txt.

CI decision. ddocs (@ai-substrate/dd) is not published to npmjs and its lockfile resolves only to private feeds, so installing it on the runner would bypass the lockfile allowlist and the seven-day quarantine. CI therefore does not install it and reports UNAVAILABLE as a warning on every run. When ddocs is published to an allowed registry it becomes a locked devDependency and the CI step drops `--unavailable=warn`.
value.receipt: dd package.json publishConfig npmjs but npmjs serves no @ai-substrate/dd; its package-lock resolves 160 packages to private feed hosts only; CI step comment records the decision

value.claim: Ruling C18. PRD 001 gains req-27: communities are discovered from their needs, and role templates are examples, not a checklist; the /pij community route and the prime prompts say so and prompt the prime to create roles for needs nothing covers. State planned (s03, s09 and s10 deliver it), source ruling C18, one changelog row, biome-formatted. Numbered 27 because the s02 PR takes req-26.
value.receipt: PRD 001 req-27 added; ddocs validate ok 0/0

value.title: ddocs sensor, CI install and proof
value.brief: AC1 to AC6. docs-system. harness/scripts/ddocs-check.ts with tests, the recipe, the checks sensor, self-check, CI step and the fires proof; plus PRD 001 req-27 (C18). CS-2.
value.receipt: AC1-AC5 checked; evidence assets/evidence/fires.txt and CI run 41766023159

value.approach: Unit tests on the pure parts (resolution, discovery, verdicts) with injected ports; a live transcript against real ddocs for the fires proof.
value.rationale: The risks are a silent pass and a wrong verdict; both are pure decisions, and the live run proves the wiring.

value: No npm install or just worktree-deps; run local checks with the main checkout's binaries.
